simple_pointers: **Record Quarterly Revenue:** Revenue rose **+14.85% YoY** to **₹9,820 Cr**, backed by 10.87 lakh total vehicle sales.
**Substantial Profit Expansion:** Profit After Tax (PAT) grew **+29.36% YoY** to **₹608 Cr**, driven by premium product mix and localized component sourcing.
**Operating Margin Strength:** Operating EBITDA margin reached **11.41%** (EBITDA: **₹1,120 Cr**), maintaining double-digit margins despite EV battery transition costs.
**EV Market Share Acceleration:** TVS iQube electric scooter crossed 58,000 units during the quarter, holding the #2 spot in Indian electric two-wheelers.
**Premium Motorcycle Leadership:** Strong traction for Apache and Raider models in urban and semi-urban markets expanded domestic market share by 140 bps.

strengths: Top-tier brand loyalty and design engineering prowess recognized globally through the BMW Motorrad manufacturing partnership.
Balanced portfolio across high-margin premium motorcycles and market-leading commuter scooters.
Rapidly scaling EV supply chain and dealer charging network.
weaknesses: EV business EBITDA margins remain lower than ICE scooters due to battery import costs.
Exposure to volatile currency availability in primary African export destinations (Nigeria, Kenya).
opportunities: Rollout of new electric three-wheeler cargo platforms and export of BMW-engineered mid-capacity bikes.
PLI (Production-Linked Incentive) scheme subsidy disbursements enhancing EV profitability.
threats: Price wars in domestic EV two-wheelers initiated by aggressive VC-funded competitors.
Fluctuations in key input commodities including aluminum, rubber, and precious metals.
